result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B uses an explicit 4/8/12/16/24/32 spacing scale throughout. It sets the filters apart with a tinted, borderless strip and groups the summary with space and a single rule between sections. A is denser and adds useful room and engineer columns, but its spacing values are ad hoc (3/6/7/9/10/14px), its filters sit in the same white bordered panel style as the schedule, and its summary puts a rule under every detail row. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A gets every gap and padding from a 4/8/12/16/24/32 token scale. Its tinted filter strip stands apart from the white panels, and it keeps a 16px inset in the filters, the schedule rows and the summary. B uses one-off values (14, 10, 9, 7, 3, 5px), and its rows have a 3px transparent left border that the column header lacks, which pushes row content 3px out of line with the headers; B also puts rules between nearly every summary line, while A separates summary groups with space.
